_doc: Bootstrap pointer for store_id=houston (Houston Heights, opens 2026-11-23). Same Square merchant and ADP login as Austin; its own Square location, ADP company, BQ dataset, Firestore collection and scrape-cache bucket. No Google Sheets (BQ is the system of record). Roster, aliases and exclusions live in bhaga_houston BQ tables, not in git.
_doc_opening_date: Before this date an empty square_transactions is expected (pre-opening payroll only); materialize skips instead of failing.
_doc_isolation: daily_refresh refuses to run unless BHAGA_BQ_DATASET, BHAGA_FIRESTORE_COLLECTION and BHAGA_GCS_CACHE_BUCKET match these three values (store_target_mismatch).

timezone._doc: Square location L6AQ95CN5NG4W timezone is America/Chicago (verified 2026-11-16 via GET /v2/locations).

square._doc: Same Square merchant as Austin, so the same OAuth secret serves both locations.

adp_run._doc: Same ADP login as Austin; the company is picked by Client ID (iid). The tenant UUID is the login's, shared by both companies. Pay schedule read from RUN Settings > Pay schedule 2026-11-16: biweekly, period 11/02-11/15, check 11/20.

employees._doc: Roster, aliases and exclusions live in BQ (bhaga_houston.employee_aliases, store_config).
